description: This file defines an abstract base class QueueBalancerBase within the Orleans.Streams namespace. It manages cluster membership updates, listener subscriptions, and provides mechanisms to initialize, shutdown, and respond to cluster changes for stream queue balancing.

classes.name: QueueBalancerBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for stream queue balancers, handling cluster membership updates, listener subscriptions, initialization, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Abstract method that should return the queues assigned to the current silo.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue balancer and starts listening for cluster changes.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the queue balancer and cancels ongoing cluster monitoring.

methods.name: SubscribeToQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Registers a listener for queue distribution change events.

methods.name: UnSubscribeFromQueueDistributionChangeEvents
methods.description: Removes a previously registered listener for queue distribution change events.

methods.name: NotifyListeners
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners about queue distribution changes.

methods.name: ListenForClusterChanges
methods.description: Async method that continuously listens for cluster membership updates and triggers change handling.

methods.name: OnClusterMembershipChange
methods.description: Abstract method to handle updates when cluster membership changes.
